# Wikilink Round Trip — write → search confirms page is indexed

# --- Setup: initialize KB ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/note.yaml
exec git add .akb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note template'

# --- Write a page, search immediately finds it ---

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write round-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/round-note.md'

exec akb search "quantum"
stdout 'notes/round-note.md'
stdout 'Round Trip Note'

# --- Write another page, search finds both ---

stdin ../note2-input.md
exec akb write second-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/second-note.md'

exec akb search "computing"
stdout 'notes/round-note.md'
stdout 'notes/second-note.md'

# --- Append updates content, search finds appended content ---

stdin ../append-input.md
exec akb append notes/round-note.md
stdout 'Appended to kb/notes/round-note.md'

exec akb search "entanglement"
stdout 'notes/round-note.md'

# --- Search by title still works after append ---

exec akb search 'Round Trip Note'
stdout 'notes/round-note.md'

# --- Search by tag works ---

exec akb search "roundtrip"
stdout 'notes/round-note.md'
stdout 'notes/second-note.md'

# --- Search with --json returns structured data ---

exec akb search --json "quantum"
stdout '"path": "kb/notes/round-note.md"'
stdout '"title": "Round Trip Note"'

# --- Core I/O still works alongside search ---

exec akb read notes/round-note.md
stdout 'Round Trip Note'
stdout 'quantum computing'
stdout 'quantum entanglement'

exec akb list
stdout 'notes/round-note.md'
stdout 'notes/second-note.md'

exec akb status
stdout 'Pages: 2'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Round Trip Note
summary: Note for write-search round trip
tags: roundtrip
---
This note contains unique content about quantum computing.

-- note2-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Second Round Trip Note
summary: Another note for round trip
tags: roundtrip
---
Content about classical computing and algorithms.

-- append-input.md --
---
Appended content about quantum entanglement.
